content:
The image shows soybean pods and stems. Key observations:

- **White fluffy/cottony growth** visible on stems (lower-center of image)
- **Large black sclerotia** clearly visible embedded in the dark mold mass on the stem (upper-center, very prominent black structure)
- Dried/brown pods mixed with some remaining green pods
- Stems appear bleached and dead

This matches **White Mold** perfectly: fluffy white fungal growth on stems with characteristic black sclerotia embedded in the mold, with dead plant tissue and some pods still attached.
